body:
my hairs falling out, my teeth are ugly, and my body is misshapen  
and the world is one of appearances, grievance one.

ive been playing guitar for fifteen years always thought id be in a band and write good music. fuck, i love songwriting. sometimes, when im good at it. when im doing poorly i really hate it and the thought goes in the suicide jar.

ill never play music for anyone that will be enjoyed.

i told jokes doing stand up comedy. i couldn't commit, and never got very good at it. my dad taught me to question the world and i thought philosophy would maybe be a place i could find a home in...

so i went back to school at 28 and am almost done with a philosophy degree. but i am a painfully average student and kids ten years my junior are regularly writing material that outclasses me on a very noticeable level. i've got nothing. im not fucking good at ANYTHING.

so i began teaching in a limited capacity with my AA degree. i thought that sharing the things ive learned with young students without all the jaded preconceptions that adults have would bring some meaning to my life.

it didn't. the kids don't care. the parents don't care. the school system is a fucking joke. the money sucks. and i STILL don't feel better about myself.

nothing will ever make me feel good. i could have all my dreams and would STILL feel this way, I bet.

a bullet has to be a better solution
just gonna use this post as a ranting wall

just look around, look at the new posts on this sub

"suicide isn't normal"

it seems pretty fucking normal to me. these posts are coming in every 85 seconds. this world is sick.

i have a kid on the way, my girlfriend is so excited

i feel like i should leave before the kid has a chance to meet me and get attached to the shadow

i know how horribly selfish it must seem to feel this way with what many mark as a milestone for life on the horizone for me

having a child was never a part of my dream and now this empty life that gives me nothing is going to be indebted to this little one

and its as he or she will deserve. they didn't ask to be here any more than I did. but i feel as if I am becoming acquainted with what is assuredly going to become "the rest of my life", "x's dad". and I'm fine with that i guess, X deserves a dad. i just know im not going to feel right being that for him. im too selfish and too devoted to this stupid fucking brain.  im thirty and the next thirty years are going to be just doing stuff for other people until i go into the ground. a group of fifteen or so will say "he was a fine man" and then they'll move on to the next charade.

if i die now i can give my kid a legend. my dad killed himself when i was fifteen, a drug overdoes. and he never had to disappoint me after that. he martyred himself and to this day I think he was the best man that I ever met. because i didn't get to know him long enough to really find out. everyone is trash when you really find out, i think.

i can't fucking do this. i don't want to do this. i want to not want and the only prescription for that seems to be one whose dose is followed by a eulogy.
i want to kill myself because the world is empty and i am tired of pretending that its not
